bullets.id: Emas naik sekitar 2% pada Senin dan pulih dari level terendah setahun. Kitco mencatat spot di $3.955,60 setelah sempat menguji resistance tepat di bawah $4.000, lalu tertahan oleh data ISM manufaktur Oktober yang naik ke 55,5 dari 54,5, di atas perkiraan. BullionVault mencatat emas naik hampir $75 dari penutupan Jumat. Pada Selasa pagi, Trading Economics mencatat emas datar di sekitar $3.949.
bullets.en: Gold rose about 2% on Monday, recovering from a one-year low. Kitco has spot at $3,955.60 after it tested resistance just below $4,000, then stalled on October’s ISM manufacturing index, which rose to 55.5 from 54.5, beating forecasts. BullionVault says gold gained almost $75 from Friday’s close. On Tuesday morning Trading Economics has gold flat at around $3,949.

bullets.id: Minyak yang turun karena tanda kemajuan diplomasi AS–Iran meredakan sebagian kekhawatiran inflasi: Trading Economics mencatat Brent sekitar $104,6 dan WTI sekitar $96,6. Namun pasar masih memperhitungkan peluang sekitar 75% kenaikan bunga Fed pada Desember, yield 10 tahun AS sekitar 4,91% dan indeks dolar sekitar 101,8. Emas masih sekitar 29,6% di bawah rekor $5.608,35 dari Januari dan turun sekitar 4,6% dalam sebulan.
bullets.en: Oil fell on signs of US–Iran diplomatic progress, easing some inflation worries: Trading Economics has Brent near $104.6 and WTI near $96.6. But markets still price about a 75% chance of a December Fed hike, the US 10-year yield is around 4.91% and the dollar index around 101.8. Gold is still about 29.6% below its $5,608.35 January record and down about 4.6% over the month.

bullets.id: Hari ini AS menggelar pemilu sela. BullionVault mencatat jajak pendapat mengunggulkan Demokrat di DPR, sementara Senat terlalu ketat untuk ditebak, dan hasil mulai keluar Selasa malam waktu AS. Dalam empat pemilu sela terakhir, emas selalu naik dalam 40 sesi setelahnya. Level yang dipantau: resistance $4.000, sekitar 1,3% di atas harga kini, dan support di area penutupan Jumat. Berikutnya ADP dan ISM jasa Rabu, lalu payroll Oktober Jumat.
bullets.en: The US holds its midterm elections today. BullionVault says polls favour the Democrats in the House while the Senate is too close to call, with results due from late Tuesday US time. In each of the last four midterms, gold rose over the 40 sessions after the vote. Levels in focus: resistance at $4,000, about 1.3% above the current price, and support around Friday’s close. Next up: ADP and ISM services Wednesday, then October payrolls Friday.

bullets.id: Harga Antam 1 gram naik Rp10.000 ke Rp2.541.000 dan buyback naik Rp25.000 ke Rp2.311.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp230.000 (sekitar 9,1%). Galeri24 naik Rp8.000 ke Rp2.451.000 (buyback Rp2.307.000, spread sekitar 5,9%) dan UBS naik Rp8.000 ke Rp2.475.000 (buyback Rp2.281.000, spread sekitar 7,8%). Harga jual Antam kini Rp90.000 di atas Galeri24 dan Rp66.000 di atas UBS.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram price rose Rp10,000 to Rp2,541,000 and buyback rose Rp25,000 to Rp2,311,000, narrowing the spread to Rp230,000 (about 9.1%). Galeri24 rose Rp8,000 to Rp2,451,000 (buyback Rp2,307,000, spread about 5.9%) and UBS rose Rp8,000 to Rp2,475,000 (buyback Rp2,281,000, spread about 7.8%). Antam’s selling price is now Rp90,000 above Galeri24’s and Rp66,000 above UBS’s.
